references.role: Painting/backdrop ONLY; no copied character, tattoos, clothes or weapons

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Coloured full-body bestiary portrait, grounded hand-painted realistic game illustration. Broad readable brushwork, smooth light-to-shadow gradients across large forms, quiet surfaces with selective crisp detail at silhouette and focal features. No uniform high-frequency texture, craquelure, fractal cracks or sharpening noise. Soft upper-left light, muted natural colours. Empty dark charcoal subtly mottled backdrop, restrained contact shading only. Entire subject, feet, tails and tips inside comfortable margins. Portrait aspect about 4:5. No captions, symbols, border or circular crop. 
One nearly ordinary human male traveller, Generation-III infiltrator living unnoticed among people. Lean adult about thirty-five, unremarkable clean-shaven face, short ash-brown hair, ordinary brown eyes. Only subtle clues: one slightly misshapen outer ear and one small pale skin patch above collar. Human proportions, two normal arms and legs; no obvious monster, claw, red eye or cybernetics. Muted grey-green canvas field jacket, faded brown trousers, practical boots, small plain travel satchel and canteen. Relaxed reserved standing pose, hands empty and visible, not menacing. Full-body three-quarter front, smooth face and broad cloth planes. Reference paint/backdrop only; no gang tattoos, weapons or copied costume.
